prior_art.known_lessons: Native capability precedes causal outcomes. V13/v14 are preserved capability nulls; v15-v17 passed. Currently/Previously and Right now/Back then are not new constructions because v15/v16 already used them, so they were rejected before this authority was sealed. A compact restricted tensor is only a reusable circuit if it predicts unseen constructions without refit and remains selective on controls.
prior_art.novelty: No v18 temporal/is-was bank exists. Sixteen reporter nouns, all target texts, all row IDs, and the This-year/Last-year and This-week/Last-week construction surfaces are history-disjoint from v4-v17. This gate opens no causal result or intervention.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides. No patch, selected module response, learned direction, causal effect, restricted tensor, or v18 intervention outcome is read.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder/digests, construction checks, full-history target-text/row-ID/reporter novelty, and the exact 64-row inventory pass.

decision: A screen freezes the exact jointly capable v18 row IDs for a separately preregistered immutable U8/H3/top-32 transfer. A null is immutable and closes v18 without inspecting or repairing causal outcomes.
